home.disciplineIntro: Different formats need different rhythms. Each service has its own dedicated portfolio experience instead of being squeezed into one generic grid.
home.statementTitle: The portfolio should feel like part of the work—not a container around it.
home.statementCopy: Typography, pacing, media, and responsive behavior are treated as one system. Nothing moves just because it can.

about.description: I work across moving image and interactive design, with the same priority in both: make the experience clear, controlled, and memorable.
about.philosophy: Good editing and good interface design solve the same problem: what should someone notice next?
about.approach: I start with hierarchy and rhythm before decoration. For video, that means story, pacing, sound and visual emphasis. For websites, it means structure, typography, responsive behavior and interaction. Motion comes after the reason for motion is clear.
about.focus: Long-form storytelling, vertical content, responsive portfolio and brand websites, interaction design, motion systems, and the details that make digital work feel authored rather than assembled.

projects.title: Cut & Hire
projects.description: A creator-services website presenting editing, clipping, thumbnail work, reviews, service packages, and clear ways to start a project.
projects.challenge: Organize a large creative-service offer without burying the work, proof, or contact path under too much information.
projects.approach: Built the experience around a strong hero, portfolio categories, creator proof, service packages, and repeated project-start actions while keeping the visual system dark and focused.
projects.result: A full creative-team website where visitors can quickly understand the offer, inspect work and reviews, compare service options, and move into contact.

projects.title: Fabri Edits
projects.description: A focused video-editor portfolio that presents long-form and short-form work, creator credentials, pricing, reviews, and direct hiring options.
projects.challenge: Give video work enough space to sell the editing quality while keeping the page simple enough for a potential client to understand the offer quickly.
projects.approach: Structured the site around a direct editor-focused hero, separate long-form and short-form showcases, creator proof, custom-pricing information, reviews, and a clear hire section.
projects.result: A compact portfolio site that connects the editor’s work, experience, social proof, and contact path in one continuous experience.

projects.title: DoorGo
projects.description: A Georgian 24/7 locksmith and access-service website for door opening, vehicle access, lock replacement, and related services.
projects.challenge: Make an urgent local service immediately understandable on mobile, where visitors often need a phone number, service type, coverage, and price context without searching.
projects.approach: Prioritized the 24/7 value proposition, phone action, core service categories, three-step process, coverage information, and repeated service/contact paths throughout the page.
projects.result: A direct service website that puts emergency actions and essential service information first while still giving visitors enough detail to choose the right service.
